question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Plead
solution:
The correct answer is 'Request'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Plead is a **verb** that means to make an** emotional appeal.**
 
• The **meaning** of the given options is as follows - 
 
 
• Request - an act of asking politely or formally for something.
 
• **Repeat **- say again something one has already said.
 
• Refuse - indicate or show that one is not willing to do something.
 
• Reply - say something in response to something someone has said.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that request is the correct synonym for the word plead.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.
